records.title: What Makes an LLM a Good Optimizer? A Trajectory Analysis of LLM-Guided Evolutionary Search
records.reason: This work analyzes LLM-guided evolutionary search as an optimizer for external problem solving; it is not an optimizer for LLM inference and presents no serving efficiency method.

records.title: Energy-Efficient Transmission in STAR-RIS Assisted Secure ISAC Networks With RSMA: An MoE-RBPPO Approach
records.reason: Publisher DOI page was inaccessible; available secondary record indicates a wireless ISAC energy-efficiency optimization paper, but primary full text could not be inspected.

records.title: Structurally Aligned Subtask-Level Memory for Software Engineering Agents
records.reason: Structurally aligned subtask-level memory improves software-engineering agent work organization, but the body does not report inference-token, latency, memory, or serving-efficiency gains. Possible context-management relation needs a direct cost evaluation.

records.title: Attention is All You Need to Defend Against Indirect Prompt Injection Attacks in LLMs
records.reason: Rennervate proposes a defense against indirect prompt injection using attention behavior. The full text concerns attack/defense efficacy, not attention-compute optimization or serving efficiency.

records.title: PRowhammer: Propagating Bit-Flips from CPU to GPU
records.reason: PRowhammer demonstrates a CPU-to-GPU memory attack that can degrade ML/LLM output via library bit flips. It is a security vulnerability study, not an efficiency improvement.
